target: Sundarpur dam authorities and mainstream media outlets, framed as concealing an infrastructure safety coverup
narrative: A coordinated network of 25 accounts amplifies near-identical posts linking to an external site claiming to host 'leaked' dam inspection documents, asserting a media-suppressed coverup of a dam leak in Sundarpur.

legal_suggestions.why: Coordinated spread of unverified claims about dam safety failure likely to cause public fear and alarm among residents in the affected area.
legal_suggestions.title: Statements conducing to public mischief (rumours causing fear or alarm)

legal_suggestions.why: 25 accounts acting in concert with co-linked, co-similar-tweet, and co-tweet signals indicate a criminal conspiracy to artificially amplify false narratives.
legal_suggestions.title: Criminal conspiracy (coordinated action)
